newsitem.title: USA: Publicker sells Masterview Window Co Inc.
newsitem.headline: Publicker sells Masterview Window Co Inc.

text.p: Publicker Industries Inc said Friday it has completed the sale of substantially all the assets of its Masterview Window Co Inc subsidiary to Masterview Acquisition Corp, a company formed by BancBoston Capital, for $15.25 million cash.
The sale is subject to certain post-closing adjustments which are not expected to be material, a statement issued by Publicker said.
Masterview, a Phoenix, Arizona-based manufacturer of aluminum windows and sliding glass doors, was acquired by Publicker in December 1990.
For 1995, Masterview had net sales of about $20 million.
